rule: Preserve unique-main and ambiguous priority; with no main and one article, admitted visible text or HTML image alt outside semantic article/ancillary contexts selects the document.

metadata.outsideArticleContent: v2-only boolean, present even when non-decisive

validation.coreReview: no blocking findings from read-only review; plumbing worker does not independently certify its own work

limitations: Twelve complete saved captures are not new live visits or universal website compatibility. No real captured ambiguous-main or standalone deep-article-without-main control was available in this corpus.
Main priority remains; misleading main landmarks can still over-narrow. Ancillary exclusions and unknown boilerplate can miss context or broaden scope.
A visible semantic article frame is not every literal article ancestor; inherited ancillary context has deliberately different visibility handling.
Extra v2 metadata consumes the existing output budget. Broader content can require strict failure or separately requested bounded plain-text fallback.
No full rendering, dynamic hydration, hidden/paid content, media, current prices/stock, genuine reviews, or shopping actions are verified.
Invalid-input text now names both policy versions; compatibility evidence concerns valid v1/default extraction, not byte-identical error messages.
Build/formatter caches are development-tool artifacts, not replay browser state. The dirty root runtime was not rebuilt or certified.
Broader live coverage, dynamic content/search, challenge handoff, SafeJS callback admission, credential/passkey and real-input gates remain open.
